material.name: COCHO_0p056_Cu_interior
material.notes: Relaxed structure metadata extracted directly from CONTCAR. Adsorbate identities/counts are derived from relaxed CONTCAR composition/connectivity; path labels only disambiguate formula-isomers and never override incompatible structure chemistry. Counts are cross-checked against POSCAR when available. Adsorption site geometry is assigned from relaxed CONTCAR coordinates; spatial distribution labels are parsed separately from the CO2RR dataset directory naming convention.

method.notes: Simulated Cu K-edge XAS using FDMNES. Multiple-scattering XAS calculation. ISAAC currently has no dedicated multiple-scattering-XAS family; family=semi_empirical is used only as the present schema-compatible bucket. FDMNES settings parsed from 4 main layer input deck(s). Convolution settings parsed from 4 auxiliary input deck(s). Calculation mode: green_function_multiple_scattering.

assets.notes: Single relaxed CONTCAR shared by all four layer-resolved Cu K-edge spectra; used for adsorption-site assignment.
Initial POSCAR used only to cross-check adsorbate composition/count against the relaxed CONTCAR.

source_scale_correction.scope: top-two only; original ISAAC record preserved in archived coverage study
source_scale_correction.reference_free_chemistry: record contains absorption, not a fabricated clean-subtracted measurement
